newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore March domestic oil export down 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore March domestic oil export down 15 pct.

text.p: Singapore domestic oil exports fell a nominal 15 percent in March to Singapore $1.294 billion year-on-year, the Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Monday.
But March exports were above the $1.206 billion exported in February, the TDB said.
In real terms, oil exports fell 18.1 percent in March to 1.797 billion.
"Oil domestic exports declined...with the softening of oil prices as well as a drop in volume due to lacklustre demand from Japan and Thailand," TDB said in a statement.
